kinds.d: Control unit with pads or insertable electrodes made for sexual electro-stimulation. A TENS or EMS unit sold for pain is in Health, Medical & Mobility.
Hand-held high-voltage, low-current device that sends a spark through a glass electrode for sensation play.

brands.d: Maker of electro-stimulation units for sexual use.
Maker of violet wands and electro-stimulation equipment.

notes: Restraint-only in effect: old models kept. ElectraStim and E-Stim Systems not on any retrieved page (the Erotic electrostimulation article names no brands), so left out. Types come from that Wikipedia article: violet wands are mechanical (Tesla coil) or solid-state, at about 35 to 65 kV with low current; TENS and EMS units are separate and medical TENS stays in Health. Brand entries Mystim and Zeus Electrosex from knowledge with sparse facts. Safety note: the article warns of heart-function risk.
